decisive_observations_proposed: PROPOSED (awaiting expert review): (1) Luteolin shows an H-3 cross-peak (~6.68/~102.9 ppm in the curated table); quercetin and kaempferol (flavonols) lack H-3. (2) B-ring pattern separates quercetin (catechol: three distinct B-ring protons) from kaempferol (single 2H-equivalent H-2'/H-6' pair at ~8.04/~130.4 and H-3'/H-5' at ~6.92/~115.1). (3) Caution: absence of H-3 in a curated table is weak evidence — overlapping or weak peaks must be considered; reviewer decides whether absence alone can decide or the case must be marked ambiguous.
plausible_alternatives: kaempferol vs luteolin share C15H10O6 and differ only in the C-3 oxygen; separation relies on the presence (luteolin) vs absence (kaempferol) of an H-3 cross-peak — an ABSENCE argument whose strength the reviewer must weigh against possible weak/overlapped H-3.
